cases.prompt: Review a React Native hook that fetches data, formats UI copy, navigates, logs analytics, and renders JSX helpers.
expect: Identifies mixed responsibilities and high cognitive load
Proposes cohesive boundaries without needless abstractions
Preserves behavior and recommends focused verification

cases.prompt: Review two similar mobile components and decide whether their duplicated logic should be extracted.
expect: Distinguishes stable shared behavior from coincidental similarity
Names a small, testable extraction when justified
